turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.text: I'm actually about to start prepping. I'm going to fill some warmed corn tortillas with seasoned ground beef, chopped onions, and fresh cilantro.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, that sounds delicious and very rewarding after a tough session on the walls. Have you had any time for your photography lately, or has work been taking up most of your creative energy?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That makes complete sense. It's important to have downtime to recharge. I'll let you get to prepping your dinner. Enjoy those tortillas!
